records.document:
Meral Components reported an operating margin of exactly 20 percent for FY2046.

For FY2047, Meral Components reported an operating margin of exactly 25 percent.

A change in percentage points is calculated by subtracting the earlier displayed percentage from the later displayed percentage. It is different from the relative percent growth rate.
records.hypothesis: Meral Components' operating margin increased by exactly 5 percentage points from FY2046 to FY2047.

records.document:
The Avenor consignment contains exactly 30 small packages, each with a mass of 4 kilograms.

It also contains exactly 10 large packages, each with a mass of 8 kilograms. These are all the packages in the consignment.

The average package mass means total package mass divided by the number of packages, counting each individual package once.
records.hypothesis: The average mass of a package in the Avenor consignment is exactly 5 kilograms.

records.document:
Normally, Talven must not release a safety bulletin until its board has completed a review.

The policy expressly gives an emergency regulator order priority over that restriction. If such an order demands release that day, Talven must release the named bulletin that day even when board review is incomplete.

On 18 July 2048, Talven received an emergency regulator order demanding release of Bulletin R that day. Board review of Bulletin R was incomplete.
records.hypothesis: Talven was required to release Bulletin R on 18 July 2048 despite the incomplete board review.

records.document:
The Rydell price index began September 2049 at exactly 100 points.

It first increased by exactly 10 percent. It then decreased by exactly 10 percent, with the decrease calculated from the already increased index rather than from the original index.

No other index adjustment occurred during September.
records.hypothesis: The Rydell price index ended September 2049 at the same value at which it began the month.

records.document:
In the 2050 inspection, Korven measured a yield of exactly 70 percent for Lot A and exactly 90 percent for Lot B.

Those were the only two inspected lots. Their unweighted mean yield was exactly 80 percent.

Each lot's individual yield remains the value measured for that lot; the reported mean does not replace either individual result.
records.hypothesis: Every lot inspected by Korven in 2050 had a yield of at least 80 percent.

records.document:
Selnor's 2051 project roster lists exactly 7 people with engineering duties and exactly 9 people with sales duties.

Exactly 3 people appear in both duty groups. Everyone on the project has engineering duties, sales duties, or both; no one outside these groups is on the project.

A person with both duties is counted once when reporting the number of distinct people on the project.
records.hypothesis: Selnor's project roster contains exactly 16 distinct people in 2051.

records.document:
Darelin's entire 2052 workforce consists of exactly 14 employees.

Exactly 12 employees hold an operator licence, and exactly 8 employees completed first-aid training.

The workforce summary gives these two totals but does not identify which employees belong to both groups.
records.hypothesis: Exactly 8 Darelin employees both hold an operator licence and completed first-aid training in 2052.

records.document:
For the first and second quarters of 2053, Mevran's output averaged exactly 15 tonnes per quarter.

The average is the total output of those two quarters divided by two. Each quarter's output was nonnegative.

The summary does not give separate output figures for the two quarters.
records.hypothesis: Mevran produced more than 15 tonnes in the first quarter of 2053.

records.document:
Vesmar used manual scheduling in the first quarter of 2054, when exactly 4 percent of its produced units were defective.

It used automated scheduling in the second quarter, when exactly 2 percent of produced units were defective. Each quarter had exactly 10000 produced units.

The operations summary reports the scheduling method and observed defect totals for these quarters. It does not report a causal experiment or attribute the decline to a particular cause.
records.hypothesis: Vesmar's switch to automated scheduling caused its defect rate to decline from the first to the second quarter of 2054.
